premise.premise: An animal finds a clever way to stay warm or dry, and a child works out how it did it.

item.title: The Green Hat
item.passage: It was raining loudly, so Jack looked out the window. He saw a little cat in his garden. The cat was very dry because it sat under a huge plant. The plant had very big leaves. The rain bounced off the top of the big leaves. Jack smiled because he understood the clever animal. The ground under the plant was safe and dry. The leaves were a great green hat!

questions.evidence: He saw a little cat in his garden.

questions.evidence: It was raining loudly, so Jack looked out the window.

questions.stem: Why was the little cat dry?
options: It was sitting below a big plant.
It was hiding in a big box.
